title: ICE FISH DASH
oneLiner: Slide a speedy penguin across the ice, grab fish, and dodge the hungry seals!
mechanics: The penguin automatically slides forward while left and right steer across icy lanes.
Collect fish for points and chain pickups for a higher score.
Avoid seals popping onto the ice; collisions cost a life.
The scrolling speed and seal frequency increase over time.
lose: Lose all three lives by hitting seals or falling into an ice crack.
scoring: Each fish collected scores points, with bonus points for consecutive fish.
